digest.component_or_area: Jira DC reconciler — capability map, runtime guards, inbound probe port
propositions: Epic-field capability contract validation occurs post-run and exits non-zero when unverifiable, rather than silently recording a wrong contract before any Software project exists

capability call sites are runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary fallback to hasattr, and capability-absent vs capability-raised states are reported distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than silently swallowed

the dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) is deleted from src, and the deletion is recorded with operator decision rationale outside the repo
the three changes (f487b62b3c, 671fa77c88, b95c097fd4) landed with full CI verification and did not cause fresh regressions in the live DC harness, which was already red from a prior commit
no test cell was deleted, skipped, or xfail-ed by this epic's three changes; the harness contains exactly one pre-existing xfail (ticket 2b16, commit 29f9627128)
